order_note: Models from most to least capable. A worker must come after the session's model in this list. Models Hermes learns from its live provider cache that are not listed here rank after it, alphabetically. Always run `hstack models --agent hermes` inside Hermes: its model ids overlap other harnesses, so the id prefix alone can't pick the harness.
